label: Page routes an e2e spec opens
means: Share of the site's page routes that an end-to-end spec opens in a real browser
goal_source: Git Crafter default goal: nearly every page route is opened by an end-to-end spec
source: state: page files in params.pages_dir and the site paths the specs of params.suites' e2e suite name, in code lines

label: Page routes with an axe check
means: Share of the site's page routes that an end-to-end spec checks for accessibility with axe
goal_source: goal: every route, as WCAG 2.2 conformance is claimed for full pages only (WCAG 2.2, Conformance Requirement 2, w3.org/TR/WCAG22); the near band is a Git Crafter default
source: state: page files in params.pages_dir and the site paths named by the e2e suite's specs that run AxeBuilder

label: Test job pass rate on main
means: Share of the latest runs on main whose test job passed; cancelled runs and runs with no site change are left out
goal_source: Git Crafter default goal: the test jobs pass on main nearly every time, so a red run means a real break
source: last N runs: gh api runs of each workflow in params.workflows (newest 100 runs a workflow), with GraphQL check runs: the last 20 runs on main of each workflow that runs there; a run counts when a test job ran, and cancelled runs and runs that skipped every test job are left out. N is 20 (ci.mjs's LAST_RUNS): enough to turn over within hours where the test workflows run many times a day

label: Skipped and todo tests
means: Tests marked skip, todo or fixme, which never run; skips on a condition are read from code and shown apart
goal_source: Git Crafter default goal: no test skips unconditionally; a skipped test checks nothing
source: state: git ls-files in params.suites; skip, todo and fixme markers in code lines, a marked block by its cases. skipIf, runIf and run-time skips are read from code, not CI, and shown apart

label: Test job, median
means: Typical minutes for the job that runs the test suites, in its latest passes
goal_source: goal: the ten-minute build, the same source as ci.latest_full_run_minutes (Kent Beck, Extreme Programming Explained, 2nd edition, 2004; Martin Fowler, Continuous Integration, martinfowler.com)
source: last N passing jobs: gh api runs of the suite workflow in params.workflows (newest 100 runs a workflow), with GraphQL check runs: the last 20 passing test jobs. N is 20 (ci.mjs's LAST_RUNS): enough to turn over within hours where the test workflows run many times a day

label: Slowest e2e shard, median
means: Typical minutes for the slowest end-to-end shard; the shards split the browser specs
goal_source: goal: the ten-minute build, the same source as ci.latest_full_run_minutes (Kent Beck, Extreme Programming Explained, 2nd edition, 2004; Martin Fowler, Continuous Integration, martinfowler.com)
source: last N passing jobs: gh api runs of the e2e workflow in params.workflows (newest 100 runs a workflow), with GraphQL check runs: the last 20 passing jobs of each shard. N is 20 (ci.mjs's LAST_RUNS): enough to turn over within hours where the test workflows run many times a day

label: Billed test job minutes, latest run
means: Runner minutes GitHub billed for the site test job and each browser test shard in their latest run
goal_source: Git Crafter default goal: the test jobs' sum at their speed goals, one suite job and one e2e job at 10 minutes each, 10 + 10 = 20; near the same at their near bands, 20 + 20 = 40. A repo with more jobs sets its own
source: latest: the latest completed run of each workflow in params.workflows whose test jobs ran, on main where the workflow runs there, else its latest pull request run (newest 100 runs a workflow); GitHub bills each job by the whole minute
